items.summary_en: Joan Weed found this shortcake recipe on the back of a magazine and decided to make it her own. While the original recipe was for a traditional layer cake, Weed decided to take a more biscuit-based approach (with delicious results). Ingredients: 3 cups sifted flour 4-1/2 tsp baking powder 1tsp salt 1/3 cup sugar 3/4 cup shortening (butter) 2 eggs 2/3 cup milk (about) 2 tbsp melted butter 2 qts strawberries 1 cup heavy cream Directions: Sift dry ingredients, then cut in shortening. items.summary_zh: 琼·威德 (Joan Weed) 在杂志背面发现了这个脆饼食谱，并决定自己制作。虽然最初的配方是传统的夹心蛋糕，但威德决定采用更多以饼干为基础的方法（结果美味）。材料： 3 杯过筛面粉 4-1/2 茶匙泡打粉 1 茶匙盐 1/3 杯糖 3/4 杯起酥油（黄油） 2 个鸡蛋 2/3 杯牛奶（约） 2 汤匙融化黄油 2 夸脱草莓 1 杯浓奶油 做法： 筛干原料，然后切成酥油
